root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Cycle 1 added RenderSpans inside web <td>/<th> WITHOUT a parent <Text> wrapper, so RNW renders each sibling Text as block-level and the four spans (bold/strike/link/code) stack vertically instead of flowing inline. The fix is structural (JSX-tree wrap), not parser-level.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: Cycle 1 changes were merged via the saga workflow; specific commit identified by `git log --oneline -- packages/happy-app/sources/components/markdown/MarkdownView.tsx` should pinpoint. The cycle-1 task-id is 20260507-055611.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Cycle 1 BA explicitly directed dev to route table cell strings through parseMarkdownSpans at render time. Dev added RenderSpans inside <td>/<th> faithfully but missed the parent <Text> wrapper that the native path used.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Without parent <Text>, RNW defaults each Text component to block/flex display because <td>/<th> don't establish text-flow context for React Native Web. The four spans stack as four single-word vertical lines.
